description: This file defines the ILifecycleObserver interface in the Orleans namespace, which provides methods for handling start and stop lifecycle notifications asynchronously.

classes.name: ILifecycleObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing lifecycle events, specifically start and stop notifications.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Asynchronously handles start notifications, with an optional cancellation token.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Asynchronously handles stop notifications, with an optional cancellation token.
